Several hours ago, I finished setting up a series of Steam Achievements-all twelve of them in number-for Daedalic Complex. With cyanic's help, the whole implementation went way more smoothly than I'd ever expected, finishing it up only in a matter of 2 weeks. :) Thanks, cyanic! (and bless you!) 

Below is the list of Achievements that are currently available:

2. A Step into the Abyss
3. Eyes on the Prize
4. +4 Grade Weaponry
5. Devotee
6. A Customer
7. A Loyal Customer

Also, here's a link to cyanic's script (which I used for setting up Achievements) uploaded on Github:

notes.title: Steam Achievements coming up! (plus some minor updates)
notes.content:
Hi there!

I'm planning to set up some Steam Achievements for Daedalic Complex pretty soon, and this will be done no later than mid or late August(no matter what). :)

There will also be at least 10 to 12 Achievements by the time the set-up is completed. Below are some details on it, though they could be changed depending on the situations:

1. 3 Achievements on usage of certain items(e.g. hp potions)
2. 3 Achievements regarding the kill count of enemies.
3. One of them on weapon upgrades
4. Another one on Exp Shrines
5. One each for the endings available within the game
6. One for the completion of the tutorial stage
7. Achievement(s) regarding parties & companions

Moreover, within 12 hours from here on, there will be simple updates on replacing Logo screens at the beginning of the game-it will be changed into something with much more simplistic designs & shorter transition time. This applies not only to Daedalic Complex, but also SHELL_BREAK, my another game. There will be no changes for the in-game contents for both games; rest assured.

Thanks for reading the announcement, and have a great day!

Best,
STDIO_934.

notes.title: Pre-announced updates and amendments are finally done!
notes.content:
Hi, everyone.


A series of planned updates and fixes, which were announced about 3 to 4 weeks ago in the early december, are now up and available! These updated features will be automatically downloaded into your local folder of Daedalic Complex via Steam. 


Changes that are made on the gaming features through the updates are listed below:


1. Internal database within the game is re-organized to enhance gaming performances.

2. Some graphic assets, such as animation sets and icons, are changed to better describe the features of items, skills, and other in-game stuff they are supposed to represent.

3. Parameter fixes, especially the ones regarding status ailments(i.e. Poison, Bleedout) chances of weapons and enemy units, have been made. However, rest assured that [u]the core parameters, like ATK, DEF, MDF, and MAT, of both the weapons and armors[/u] are not changed at all; they remains the same as before.

4. Graphic and sound resources, which are not used in the game, have been found and deleted.



With these updates active, there might be a slight decrease in overall gameplay difficulty. Still, the game itself should be challenging and hard as it has been, so don't worry about getting your gaming experiences spoiled.

I truly hope you will enjoy all these updated features!


Sincerely,
ghilplip934.

notes.title: I'm starting up a new discussion page where players can share their issues and questions regarding the game.
notes.content:
Hello, everyone.


I've just posted a new discussion thread in the community hub of Daedalic Complex so that players and fans can share their issues(be it technical or gameplay-related) and questions. Make sure to visit there if you want to share your own gaming issue(s) or get some help regarding the game, Daedalic Complex!


Furthermore, if you have any opinions on what kind of updates would be needed in the future, you can also share them via discussion tab. I'm always up to making you full enjoy my game. :)


Best,
ghilplip934.

notes.title: A plan for some minor revisions & adjustments in near future.
notes.content:
Hello, fans!


I'm now thinking of making some small adjustments and updates around the late december(or next january) after I get myself done with the remaining works for the upcoming game end of this year, SHELL_BREAK.

The updates in discuss won't be too large in scale to change the game upside-down; these adjustments are mainly for enhancing performances by revising the internal database(which is quite significantly related to usage of the computer memory) of the program.

Along with such database modifications, I'm also thinking of adding and(or) fixing some gaming features(such as graphics of certain objects, descriptions for items and gears, etc) just a bit so that players won't be unnecessarily feeling uncomfortable while playing the game, Daedalic Complex.

Should the updates be really made regarding those above, I'll let you know via notifications ASAP.


Best wishes,
ghilplip934.

notes.title: A notice on discount plans for near future, end of this year.
notes.content:
Hello, everyone.


First of all, it was a real shame that I couldn't put some discounts on Daedalic Complex for this year's Autumn Sale period. At the time of first launching the game, I never thought of anything about Black Friday period on late november, this month, failing to plan wisely for the entire month's discounts and promotions. ;(

Still, there will be a nice, pre-planned discount, with its sales rate bigger than that of the launch discount, on the product in late december this year for sure, so keep your eyes on Daedalic Complex for its upcoming sales. Please don't miss the chance taking place in near future, people!

Also, should there be any kind of questions regarding Daedalic Complex, let me know via Steam Community Hub so that I can give you a quick, detailed answer.


Best,
ghilplip934.

notes.title: A short notice about uploading a guide to the main game.
notes.content:
Hello, 


After some considerations, I've decided to upload the guide file to the main game just like I did to the demo version. 

In order to check out the file, first you'll have to update your game, go into the directory folder where the game is installed, and then look for the pdf file. The software will be automatically updated whenever it is able to do so, as you all know, so be sure to check whether the game is up to the date or not. :)

Should there be 'any' bugs or problems, please let me know ASAP so that I can fix it right away.


Best regards to all reading this notice,
ghilplip934.

notes.title: A guide for the demo version is now available.
notes.content:
Hello to all!


I've just made an update to the demo version of Daedalic Complex so that the game folder will also include a single pdf file, which is a guide document to help you play the demo without any major difficulties.

Practically, the guide also works the same for a tutorial stage of the full game, too. However, I'm still not sure if it's going to be beneficial even for the people who already bought and are up to play the full copy of Daedalic Complex; thus, I won't upload the guide file(which only helps you get through the tutorial stage) to the full-version program until the considerable amounts of requests are made for sure. 

The guide is not supposed to be a 'mandatory' material you have to go through in order to play the demo. It just helps you play the game without serious difficulties or problems. So, should there be any occasion where you can't clear the demo at all, you'll just have to refer to the guide file in the program folder.


Hope it's gonna be a great help for you to enjoy the demo!


Best regards,
ghilplip934.

notes.title: Full version finally released and available!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!


The full-version game of Daedalic Complex has been finally released and became available for everyone. There will be a 20% discount on the full-price of the game for a week starting from today, 8th of November, so don't miss the chance!

I really wish the full game here will provide a challenging, and yet fun and exciting experience to all of you playing Daedalic Complex. Should there be any bug or error, I ask you to let me know about them fast so that I could make adjustments or bug-fixes ASAP for your gaming experiences.


Thank you all for reading this announcement!

Best regards,
ghilplip934.

notes.title: A minor update to the demo version program.
notes.content:
Hello to all!


I've just made some few, minor updates for the demo version game of Daedalic Complex, all of which were already applied to the not-released-yet full version as well.

Contents of the updates are followings:

1. Faster movement speed for characters in the game
2. Changes of sprite designs of some characters


These updates are not huge enough to change the whole demo version upside down, so don't worry whether your gaming experience so far will go ruined; I made these slight changes only to keep up with the improved functions and features of upcoming full-version of the game. :)

Hope you keep enjoying the demo-version of Daedalic Complex!


With my best regards,
ghilplip934

notes.content:
Hello, folks!

A planned, release date for the full version of Daedalic Complex became earlier than the original date, making it available from 8th of november this year. In other words, on 8th(other than 15th) you can play the whole game straight away, enjoying all the things Daedalic Complex has to offer for you!

I'm hoping you'll enjoy the full game just as you did with the demo version. :)


Best regards,
ghilplip934.

notes.title: A playable demo version is now avaliable!
notes.content:
Hello to all!


[b]A free demo version of the game is now available[/b] for everyone to be played right away. 

This demonstration version contains a single stage, which is also included in the main game to serve as a tutorial, with its estimated playing time to be around 30 to 60 minutes. It does not have all the equipments, items, status ailments and et cetera just like the main game, but still, the demo version can alone do its job of letting you know the basic concepts and ideas of Daedalic Complex that is coming on 15th of november this year.


Hope you enjoy playing this demo version and have fun. See you around!

Best regards,
ghilplip934.

notes.title: Daedalic Complex coming out about 3 weeks later!
notes.content:
Hello, folks!

A dungeon-crawling and yet challenging RPG game, Daedalic Complex, is currently planned to be released in about 3 weeks from this moment. All the development procedures, necessary to make the game fully-functional and ready-to-play, have already been completed. Thus, you'll be able to enjoy every challenging experience Daedalic Complex will provide you right from the moment the app is purchased and installed!


Still, should there be 'any' bug or error found in the game after its release, I'll make sure that these should be fixed as soon as possible. So, please look forward to its release date, 15th of november, with an anticipation for approx. 8 to 10 hours of challenging and yet exciting gameplay you'll enjoy.


Best regards to all reading this,
ghilplip934.
